title: My AI-built football game had 18 minutes where nobody moved
author: the_not_white_knight
selftext:
I wanted to build a football game where the players could read the match properly. In one game, nobody moved from the 66th to the 84th minute.

I tried 16x speed. Still stuck. Very efficient time-wasting.

GPT-6 Pro built the engine foundation. Later I worked with Claude on the engine, with another session on design. We measured changes incrementally against frozen earlier versions, checking what improved and what got worse.

Talking it through with Claude got that bug fixed. After all that, I started to really like the way it played.

Still in development. I made a video about it:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zv0iZWOmvdY

comments.author: Otterly_Delicious
comments.body: Very cool. I'm making a hockey management sim right now. I have a lot of the systems in place but I keep iterating to make the sim feel good. Later I'd like to add in a match you can watch like you have, but for now it's just a text based play by play.

replies.author: the_not_white_knight
replies.body:
Yeah I know what you mean with the constant iterations lol. I started by building out the fundamental systems, then kept building on them until things started to click...which was an amazing feeling

Text-based matches are cool too, having a deterministic sim underneath gives you something consistent to build the visual layer around. Mine is a hybrid physics sim because you can also jump in and play with a controller, so it isn’t purely management.

I’m also working on a basketball sim that started with text and now has 3D animation. Still a lot to fix there lol, but it’s definitely possible (mainly because basketball is kinda difficult to animate in 3D). Were you thinking 2D or 3D for the hockey matches?

replies.author: Otterly_Delicious
replies.body:
I am thinking of trying 3D. I haven't done anything 3D yet so it should be an interesting journey. I am also toying with the idea of seeing if I'm able to create play by play announcers to go along with it. 

Basketball and football, you're very ambitious! Right now working on one project is already taking up a lot of my free time!

replies.author: the_not_white_knight
replies.body: Haha yeah, basketball has been a challenge to animate 😂 Play-by-play would be a cool addition. Are you thinking of generating it directly from the match events?
